| M.ORCH-T2006 | 2026-11-22 | fix | closed | Diagnosis confirmed the Nov18 11PM-4AM blind gap is NOT a ClaudeMeterProbe asking/backoff bug: continue root-causing PaceLedger's window-bucketing and land the real fix. Evidence (MindAttic.Log.db, MindAttic.Orchestrator app, Component=Daemon, shampoo1232@mindattic.com): pace ledger closed window 'Nov 18 11:00 PM-4:00 AM' BLIND at 2026-11-19T10:02:16Z (peak 11%, 'Claude meter unseen for 4h while 2.6M were spent, 5 calls held'). But the wall-clock-equivalent UTC span (local=UTC-6; Nov18 20:00Z-Nov19 10:00Z) shows ClaudeMeterProbe asking and SUCCEEDING every ~4-5min continuously the whole night (asks climbing 17%->...->12%, zero Fail()/NoMeterBackoff/'another account's' messages). This refutes all 3 of the ticket's hypotheses: Tick() ran, Due()/IdleDue() fired, and every AskCoreAsync succeeded -- ClaudeMeterProbe itself has no gap here. The real readings landed in a DIFFERENT, adjacent pace-ledger window ('Nov 18 8:30 PM-1:30 AM', ended 12% peak, many samples) that overlaps/abuts the blind one by ~2.5h instead of the usual ~5h spacing between windows. Root cause is almost certainly in PaceLedger.Due()/Build() (src/MindAttic.Orchestrator.Core/Budget/PaceLedger.cs): windows are bucketed purely by each usage_sample's own resets_at via Near() (+-10min); if Claude's reported resets_at for the same real window drifted/glitched on one read (or the account briefly carried a stray sample with a different resets_at), that single sample gets isolated into its own 10-min bucket as a separate 'window' with only 1 sample, graded Blind, while every other sample from the same stretch is correctly bucketed into the neighboring window -- producing exactly this 'one 11% sample then nothing for hours' artifact with no real probe failure involved. NEXT STEP: pull the raw usage_samples rows (ResetUtc, Percent, AtUtc, Account) for shampoo1232 between 2026-11-19T02:00Z and 2026-11-19T10:00Z from the live store (SQL Server per OrchestratorServer once M.ORCH-T658 cutover, or data/orchestrator.db pace_ledger/usage_samples if not yet migrated) to see the exact resets_at values and confirm whether it's a single stray sample, a reset-time rounding edge case, or a brief cross-account mix-in; then fix PaceLedger's bucketing (e.g. merging near-adjacent windows for the same account, or ignoring/re-bucketing a lone outlier sample) rather than touching ClaudeMeterProbe's Due()/IdleDue()/backoff logic, which this investigation showed was working correctly throughout. No source files were changed for this ticket; all queries were read-only against a scratch copy of the log db. | 629c6f6a |

8b54d14c Claim-time prerequisite check: next --claim (and redelegation) re-reads a ticket's open 'requires' prerequisites, its part-of ancestors' and an unapproved part-of epic from the ticket database (Allocate.OpenPrerequisites) and skips it, since the CLI plans on the daemon's published snapshot, whose links trail a fresh tickets ticket link by a tick plus its age; links is change-tracked, so the T1938 version cache wasn't the cause (M.ORCH-T2059); f6b02ece Health learning and tick lines as settings: HealthLearnPercentile (90), HealthLearnChangesKept (200), HealthTickDegradedSeconds (60), HealthTickUnhealthySeconds (180) in OrchestratorSettings, the Settings modal and orchestrator settings flags, validated in HealthThresholds.Problem, daemon:tick graded on HealthThresholds.TickSeconds; 23a4af1a Wake an idle agent for its mail: Sessions/Wakeups.cs, a coalescing wakeup queue kept as the 'wakeups' state row (one entry per CLI and idle stretch, one reason of each kind, each said once, kept across restarts); DeliverMail queues a 'mail' wake for a live agent idle past AllocateWaker.Settle (not at a window stop nor on a /goal) with unread mail and drops it once taken or busy, and the daemon says each new wake once in the log and the Needs-you alert, never typing into the CLI (M.ORCH-T2067); 1ecf62ba LinkProbe: a closed dashboard or Tickets Desktop (presence gone) grades pass, TermHost and CLI gone stay warn; HEALTH.md and LinkProbeTests follow (M.ORCH-T2062); f4f46648 Agent mailbox: agent_messages table (id, to_agent, from_agent, unit, body, sent_utc, read_utc; SQLite step 22, server schema 11) behind Sessions/Mailbox.cs (send, unread, list, mark read); SessionContext.Agent read from the session_states value; the daemon (Daemon.Mail.cs, on the wake lease) leaves each live agent's unread mail as nudge-<pid>-mail.txt and marks it read once the hook has taken the file younger than 20 min; orchestrator mail send/list, sending from MINDATTIC_AGENT_ID by default; waking an idle agent for its mail filed as M.ORCH-T2067 (M.ORCH-T1745); 8131df51 Keep-N local backups: BackupKeepLocal setting (default 30, the Launcher's backup --keep example; 0 keeps every one) in OrchestratorSettings, the Vault settings modal and orchestrator settings --backup-keep; Backup now calls BackupService.Prune(keep) after a good local backup; fix the stale 'stub groups' comment above the Backup & Restore toolbar group (M.ORCH-T2064); bcb61a9c Agents panel under each login in the tree: each agent the agents table has on that login (retired ones left out), running first, its role then its state, unit and last heartbeat, with its id and runtime on hover (MainViewModel.Agents.cs); read off the UI thread with the refresh and a pushed snapshot's figures, spread over the tabs by owner in ApplyTabs, no poll of its own (M.ORCH-T1747); 51e78a11 Role catalog sync: Scheduling/RoleCatalog.cs reads mindattic-agent-standard\shared\roles\*.md frontmatter (name, description, tools, model, effort, optional takes; README's rules, render-abilities.ps1's Read-Role parser) into the roles table, upserting by name with its source and dropping file-sourced rows whose file is gone (broken files skipped with a warning, hand-made rows kept); the daemon syncs it the first tick and whenever the folder's fingerprint changes (Daemon.Roles.cs), so Roles.ModelOf and agents new see the catalog (M.ORCH-T2066); fa5b1d5a orchestrator agents new/list/pause/resume/retire: AgentBook over the agents table; new <role> writes an idle agent's row under a stable agt- id (role checked against the roles table and mindattic-agent-standard\shared\roles, owner this CLI's login or --owner), pause/resume/retire move its state and keep the row; the /agent ability filed as M.ORCH-T2065 (M.ORCH-T1744); a508eda8 Role on handouts and assignments: a ticket's role is its role:<name> label (OpenTicketSource -> Snapshot.Roles -> QueueItem.Role), else implementer (Scheduling/Roles.cs); Allocate.Handout and Assignment carry it (assignments.role, SQLite step 21, server schema 10), next --claim prints it, and ModelChoice.For takes the role's model from the roles table first (after your override), falling back to its own rules when the role names none (M.ORCH-T1746); 48f57d3e Change-only health alerts: Health/HealthAlerts.cs grades each report as the hub keeps it (AppBusHub.HealthTaken -> Daemon.ReportHealth); a check instance alerts unhealthy after HealthFailureThreshold in a row (default 2) and its recovery after HealthSuccessThreshold (default 1), once per transition, degraded never; toast/push plus a Psst text with HealthAlerts on; alerted set kept in the database across restarts; settings in the Settings modal and CLI (--health-alerts, --health-failure-threshold, --health-success-threshold); tests for no repeat spam (M.ORCH-T2039); f939383d Project settings button in the toolbar's Settings group: opens MindAttic Vault at the selected CLI's project's Launcher roster entry (alias, description, color, scheme) via LauncherProjectSettings.SettingFor, ported from the Launcher's ProjectSetupMenu.SettingFor (raw roster index -> <prefix>:projects:<i>:tabAlias, by name or folder) with a unit test; disabled with a tooltip while no CLI tab is selected (M.ORCH-T2026); 954b8d38 Daemon runs the health probes: Daemon.Health.cs launches orchestrator probe machine/links/azure --once as hidden processes on their own intervals (--health-probe-machine/links/azure-seconds, 30/30/300, 0 off; Settings modal and CLI), one run of each at a time, killed 60 s past its timeout, under the health-probes.lock lease; a probe that couldn't run (exit 3 with stderr, other code, no start, killed) is logged once per new failure and again when it recovers; HEALTH.md section 6 (M.ORCH-T2037); d73216f2 Health view in the global tab's Misc area: one card per probe check (status, reading, the line it was graded against with learned/configured, a sparkline of its readings and the recent-grade strip, its output line), the overall status in the HEALTH header, an empty note before any report (M.ORCH-T2034); 8b54d14c Claim-time prerequisite check: next --claim (and redelegation) re-reads a ticket's open 'requires' prerequisites, its part-of ancestors' and an unapproved part-of epic from the ticket database (Allocate.OpenPrerequisites) and skips it, since the CLI plans on the daemon's published snapshot, whose links trail a fresh tickets ticket link by a tick plus its age; links is change-tracked, so the T1938 version cache wasn't the cause (M.ORCH-T2059); f6b02ece Health learning and tick lines as settings: HealthLearnPercentile (90), HealthLearnChangesKept (200), HealthTickDegradedSeconds (60), HealthTickUnhealthySeconds (180) in OrchestratorSettings, the Settings modal and orchestrator settings flags, validated in HealthThresholds.Problem, daemon:tick graded on HealthThresholds.TickSeconds; HEALTH.md section 5 describes the learning (M.ORCH-T2063); 9ebf555d Ticket-DB sync: on a moved remote, git fetch origin main + git merge --no-edit origin/main (aborting a failed merge) and push again, up to 3 times, instead of pull --rebase --autostash that could sweep other agents' work in the shared Tickets checkout (M.ORCH-T2060); 23a4af1a Wake an idle agent for its mail: Sessions/Wakeups.cs, a coalescing wakeup queue kept as the 'wakeups' state row (one entry per CLI and idle stretch, one reason of each kind, each said once, kept across restarts); DeliverMail queues a 'mail' wake for a live agent idle past AllocateWaker.Settle (not at a window stop nor on a /goal) with unread mail and drops it once taken or busy, and the daemon says each new wake once in the log and the Needs-you alert, never typing into the CLI (M.ORCH-T2067); 1ecf62ba LinkProbe: a closed dashboard or Tickets Desktop (presence gone) grades pass, TermHost and CLI gone stay warn; HEALTH.md and LinkProbeTests follow (M.ORCH-T2062); f4f46648 Agent mailbox: agent_messages table (id, to_agent, from_agent, unit, body, sent_utc, read_utc; SQLite step 22, server schema 11) behind Sessions/Mailbox.cs (send, unread, list, mark read); SessionContext.Agent read from the session_states value; the daemon (Daemon.Mail.cs, on the wake lease) leaves each live agent's unread mail as nudge-<pid>-mail.txt and marks it read once the hook has taken the file younger than 20 min; orchestrator mail send/list, sending from MINDATTIC_AGENT_ID by default; waking an idle agent for its mail filed as M.ORCH-T2067 (M.ORCH-T1745); 8131df51 Keep-N local backups: BackupKeepLocal setting (default 30, the Launcher's backup --keep example; 0 keeps every one) in OrchestratorSettings, the Vault settings modal and orchestrator settings --backup-keep; Backup now calls BackupService.Prune(keep) after a good local backup; fix the stale 'stub groups' comment above the Backup & Restore toolbar group (M.ORCH-T2064); bcb61a9c Agents panel under each login in the tree: each agent the agents table has on that login (retired ones left out), running first, its role then its state, unit and last heartbeat, with its id and runtime on hover (MainViewModel.Agents.cs); read off the UI thread with the refresh and a pushed snapshot's figures, spread over the tabs by owner in ApplyTabs, no poll of its own (M.ORCH-T1747); 51e78a11 Role catalog sync: Scheduling/RoleCatalog.cs reads mindattic-agent-standard\shared\roles\*.md frontmatter (name, description, tools, model, effort, optional takes; README's rules, render-abilities.ps1's Read-Role parser) into the roles table, upserting by name with its source and dropping file-sourced rows whose file is gone (broken files skipped with a warning, hand-made rows kept); the daemon syncs it the first tick and whenever the folder's fingerprint changes (Daemon.Roles.cs), so Roles.ModelOf and agents new see the catalog (M.ORCH-T2066); fa5b1d5a orchestrator agents new/list/pause/resume/retire: AgentBook over the agents table; new <role> writes an idle agent's row under a stable agt- id (role checked against the roles table and mindattic-agent-standard\shared\roles, owner this CLI's login or --owner), pause/resume/retire move its state and keep the row; the /agent ability filed as M.ORCH-T2065 (M.ORCH-T1744); a508eda8 Role on handouts and assignments: a ticket's role is its role:<name> label (OpenTicketSource -> Snapshot.Roles -> QueueItem.Role), else implementer (Scheduling/Roles.cs); Allocate.Handout and Assignment carry it (assignments.role, SQLite step 21, server schema 10), next --claim prints it, and ModelChoice.For takes the role's model from the roles table first (after your override), falling back to its own rules when the role names none (M.ORCH-T1746); 48f57d3e Change-only health alerts: Health/HealthAlerts.cs grades each report as the hub keeps it (AppBusHub.HealthTaken -> Daemon.ReportHealth); a check instance alerts unhealthy after HealthFailureThreshold in a row (default 2) and its recovery after HealthSuccessThreshold (default 1), once per transition, degraded never; toast/push plus a Psst text with HealthAlerts on; alerted set kept in the database across restarts; settings in the Settings modal and CLI (--health-alerts, --health-failure-threshold, --health-success-threshold); tests for no repeat spam (M.ORCH-T2039); f939383d Project settings button in the toolbar's Settings group: opens MindAttic Vault at the selected CLI's project's Launcher roster entry (alias, description, color, scheme) via LauncherProjectSettings.SettingFor, ported from the Launcher's ProjectSetupMenu.SettingFor (raw roster index -> <prefix>:projects:<i>:tabAlias, by name or folder) with a unit test; disabled with a tooltip while no CLI tab is selected (M.ORCH-T2026); 954b8d38 Daemon runs the health probes: Daemon.Health.cs launches orchestrator probe machine/links/azure --once as hidden processes on their own intervals (--health-probe-machine/links/azure-seconds, 30/30/300, 0 off; Settings modal and CLI), one run of each at a time, killed 60 s past its timeout, under the health-probes.lock lease; a probe that couldn't run (exit 3 with stderr, other code, no start, killed) is logged once per new failure and again when it recovers; HEALTH.md section 6 (M.ORCH-T2037); d73216f2 Health view in the global tab's Misc area: one card per probe check (status, reading, the line it was graded against with learned/configured, a sparkline of its readings and the recent-grade strip, its output line), the overall status in the HEALTH header, an empty note before any report (M.ORCH-T2034); defbed4a Backup & Restore toolbar button enabled: BackupRestoreWindow offers Backup now (BackupService.Run over the roster's SQLite databases, the web apps' Azure SQL databases via Kickstart.List when ticked, and AppData, then AzureBlobUpload.UploadAndPrune with the default options when ticked) and Restore from folder (BackupRestore.Run on the picked folder, newest by default via BackupFolders.FindNewest), each with timestamped progress lines, off the UI thread, cancellable backup (M.ORCH-T2050)) | bf31fe94 |

8b54d14c Claim-time prerequisite check: next --claim (and redelegation) re-reads a ticket's open 'requires' prerequisites, its part-of ancestors' and an unapproved part-of epic from the ticket database (Allocate.OpenPrerequisites) and skips it, since the CLI plans on the daemon's published snapshot, whose links trail a fresh tickets ticket link by a tick plus its age; links is change-tracked, so the T1938 version cache wasn't the cause (M.ORCH-T2059); f6b02ece Health learning and tick lines as settings: HealthLearnPercentile (90), HealthLearnChangesKept (200), HealthTickDegradedSeconds (60), HealthTickUnhealthySeconds (180) in OrchestratorSettings, the Settings modal and orchestrator settings flags, validated in HealthThresholds.Problem, daemon:tick graded on HealthThresholds.TickSeconds; HEALTH.md section 5 describes the learning (M.ORCH-T2063); 9ebf555d Ticket-DB sync: on a moved remote, git fetch origin main + git merge --no-edit origin/main (aborting a failed merge) and push again, up to 3 times, instead of pull --rebase --autostash that could sweep other agents' work in the shared Tickets checkout (M.ORCH-T2060); 23a4af1a Wake an idle agent for its mail: Sessions/Wakeups.cs, a coalescing wakeup queue kept as the 'wakeups' state row (one entry per CLI and idle stretch, one reason of each kind, each said once, kept across restarts); DeliverMail queues a 'mail' wake for a live agent idle past AllocateWaker.Settle (not at a window stop nor on a /goal) with unread mail and drops it once taken or busy, and the daemon says each new wake once in the log and the Needs-you alert, never typing into the CLI (M.ORCH-T2067); 1ecf62ba LinkProbe: a closed dashboard or Tickets Desktop (presence gone) grades pass, TermHost and CLI gone stay warn; HEALTH.md and LinkProbeTests follow (M.ORCH-T2062); f4f46648 Agent mailbox: agent_messages table (id, to_agent, from_agent, unit, body, sent_utc, read_utc; SQLite step 22, server schema 11) behind Sessions/Mailbox.cs (send, unread, list, mark read); SessionContext.Agent read from the session_states value; the daemon (Daemon.Mail.cs, on the wake lease) leaves each live agent's unread mail as nudge-<pid>-mail.txt and marks it read once the hook has taken the file younger than 20 min; orchestrator mail send/list, sending from MINDATTIC_AGENT_ID by default; waking an idle agent for its mail filed as M.ORCH-T2067 (M.ORCH-T1745); 8131df51 Keep-N local backups: BackupKeepLocal setting (default 30, the Launcher's backup --keep example; 0 keeps every one) in OrchestratorSettings, the Vault settings modal and orchestrator settings --backup-keep; Backup now calls BackupService.Prune(keep) after a good local backup; fix the stale 'stub groups' comment above the Backup & Restore toolbar group (M.ORCH-T2064); bcb61a9c Agents panel under each login in the tree: each agent the agents table has on that login (retired ones left out), running first, its role then its state, unit and last heartbeat, with its id and runtime on hover (MainViewModel.Agents.cs); read off the UI thread with the refresh and a pushed snapshot's figures, spread over the tabs by owner in ApplyTabs, no poll of its own (M.ORCH-T1747); 51e78a11 Role catalog sync: Scheduling/RoleCatalog.cs reads mindattic-agent-standard\shared\roles\*.md frontmatter (name, description, tools, model, effort, optional takes; README's rules, render-abilities.ps1's Read-Role parser) into the roles table, upserting by name with its source and dropping file-sourced rows whose file is gone (broken files skipped with a warning, hand-made rows kept); the daemon syncs it the first tick and whenever the folder's fingerprint changes (Daemon.Roles.cs), so Roles.ModelOf and agents new see the catalog (M.ORCH-T2066); fa5b1d5a orchestrator agents new/list/pause/resume/retire: AgentBook over the agents table; new <role> writes an idle agent's row under a stable agt- id (role checked against the roles table and mindattic-agent-standard\shared\roles, owner this CLI's login or --owner), pause/resume/retire move its state and keep the row; the /agent ability filed as M.ORCH-T2065 (M.ORCH-T1744); a508eda8 Role on handouts and assignments: a ticket's role is its role:<name> label (OpenTicketSource -> Snapshot.Roles -> QueueItem.Role), else implementer (Scheduling/Roles.cs); Allocate.Handout and Assignment carry it (assignments.role, SQLite step 21, server schema 10), next --claim prints it, and ModelChoice.For takes the role's model from the roles table first (after your override), falling back to its own rules when the role names none (M.ORCH-T1746); 48f57d3e Change-only health alerts: Health/HealthAlerts.cs grades each report as the hub keeps it (AppBusHub.HealthTaken -> Daemon.ReportHealth); a check instance alerts unhealthy after HealthFailureThreshold in a row (default 2) and its recovery after HealthSuccessThreshold (default 1), once per transition, degraded never; toast/push plus a Psst text with HealthAlerts on; alerted set kept in the database across restarts; settings in the Settings modal and CLI (--health-alerts, --health-failure-threshold, --health-success-threshold); tests for no repeat spam (M.ORCH-T2039); f939383d Project settings button in the toolbar's Settings group: opens MindAttic Vault at the selected CLI's project's Launcher roster entry (alias, description, color, scheme) via LauncherProjectSettings.SettingFor, ported from the Launcher's ProjectSetupMenu.SettingFor (raw roster index -> <prefix>:projects:<i>:tabAlias, by name or folder) with a unit test; disabled with a tooltip while no CLI tab is selected (M.ORCH-T2026); 954b8d38 Daemon runs the health probes: Daemon.Health.cs launches orchestrator probe machine/links/azure --once as hidden processes on their own intervals (--health-probe-machine/links/azure-seconds, 30/30/300, 0 off; Settings modal and CLI), one run of each at a time, killed 60 s past its timeout, under the health-probes.lock lease; a probe that couldn't run (exit 3 with stderr, other code, no start, killed) is logged once per new failure and again when it recovers; HEALTH.md section 6 (M.ORCH-T2037); d73216f2 Health view in the global tab's Misc area: one card per probe check (status, reading, the line it was graded against with learned/configured, a sparkline of its readings and the recent-grade strip, its output line), the overall status in the HEALTH header, an empty note before any report (M.ORCH-T2034); defbed4a Backup & Restore toolbar button enabled: BackupRestoreWindow offers Backup now (BackupService.Run over the roster's SQLite databases, the web apps' Azure SQL databases via Kickstart.List when ticked, and AppData, then AzureBlobUpload.UploadAndPrune with the default options when ticked) and Restore from folder (BackupRestore.Run on the picked folder, newest by default via BackupFolders.FindNewest), each with timestamped progress lines, off the UI thread, cancellable backup (M.ORCH-T2050)) | 920250ce |

DeliverMail queues a 'mail' wake for a live agent idle past AllocateWaker.Settle (not at a window stop nor on a /goal) with unread mail and drops it once taken or busy, and the daemon says each new wake once in the log and the Needs-you alert, never typing into the CLI (M.ORCH-T2067); 1ecf62ba LinkProbe: a closed dashboard or Tickets Desktop (presence gone) grades pass, TermHost and CLI gone stay warn; HEALTH.md and LinkProbeTests follow (M.ORCH-T2062); f4f46648 Agent mailbox: agent_messages table (id, to_agent, from_agent, unit, body, sent_utc, read_utc; SQLite step 22, server schema 11) behind Sessions/Mailbox.cs (send, unread, list, mark read); SessionContext.Agent read from the session_states value; the daemon (Daemon.Mail.cs, on the wake lease) leaves each live agent's unread mail as nudge-<pid>-mail.txt and marks it read once the hook has taken the file younger than 20 min; orchestrator mail send/list, sending from MINDATTIC_AGENT_ID by default; waking an idle agent for its mail filed as M.ORCH-T2067 (M.ORCH-T1745); 8131df51 Keep-N local backups: BackupKeepLocal setting (default 30, the Launcher's backup --keep example; 0 keeps every one) in OrchestratorSettings, the Vault settings modal and orchestrator settings --backup-keep; Backup now calls BackupService.Prune(keep) after a good local backup; fix the stale 'stub groups' comment above the Backup & Restore toolbar group (M.ORCH-T2064); bcb61a9c Agents panel under each login in the tree: each agent the agents table has on that login (retired ones left out), running first, its role then its state, unit and last heartbeat, with its id and runtime on hover (MainViewModel.Agents.cs); read off the UI thread with the refresh and a pushed snapshot's figures, spread over the tabs by owner in ApplyTabs, no poll of its own (M.ORCH-T1747); 51e78a11 Role catalog sync: Scheduling/RoleCatalog.cs reads mindattic-agent-standard\shared\roles\*.md frontmatter (name, description, tools, model, effort, optional takes; README's rules, render-abilities.ps1's Read-Role parser) into the roles table, upserting by name with its source and dropping file-sourced rows whose file is gone (broken files skipped with a warning, hand-made rows kept); the daemon syncs it the first tick and whenever the folder's fingerprint changes (Daemon.Roles.cs), so Roles.ModelOf and agents new see the catalog (M.ORCH-T2066); fa5b1d5a orchestrator agents new/list/pause/resume/retire: AgentBook over the agents table; new <role> writes an idle agent's row under a stable agt- id (role checked against the roles table and mindattic-agent-standard\shared\roles, owner this CLI's login or --owner), pause/resume/retire move its state and keep the row; the /agent ability filed as M.ORCH-T2065 (M.ORCH-T1744); a508eda8 Role on handouts and assignments: a ticket's role is its role:<name> label (OpenTicketSource -> Snapshot.Roles -> QueueItem.Role), else implementer (Scheduling/Roles.cs); Allocate.Handout and Assignment carry it (assignments.role, SQLite step 21, server schema 10), next --claim prints it, and ModelChoice.For takes the role's model from the roles table first (after your override), falling back to its own rules when the role names none (M.ORCH-T1746); 48f57d3e Change-only health alerts: Health/HealthAlerts.cs grades each report as the hub keeps it (AppBusHub.HealthTaken -> Daemon.ReportHealth); a check instance alerts unhealthy after HealthFailureThreshold in a row (default 2) and its recovery after HealthSuccessThreshold (default 1), once per transition, degraded never; toast/push plus a Psst text with HealthAlerts on; alerted set kept in the database across restarts; settings in the Settings modal and CLI (--health-alerts, --health-failure-threshold, --health-success-threshold); tests for no repeat spam (M.ORCH-T2039); f939383d Project settings button in the toolbar's Settings group: opens MindAttic Vault at the selected CLI's project's Launcher roster entry (alias, description, color, scheme) via LauncherProjectSettings.SettingFor, ported from the Launcher's ProjectSetupMenu.SettingFor (raw roster index -> <prefix>:projects:<i>:tabAlias, by name or folder) with a unit test; disabled with a tooltip while no CLI tab is selected (M.ORCH-T2026); 954b8d38 Daemon runs the health probes: Daemon.Health.cs launches orchestrator probe machine/links/azure --once as hidden processes on their own intervals (--health-probe-machine/links/azure-seconds, 30/30/300, 0 off; Settings modal and CLI), one run of each at a time, killed 60 s past its timeout, under the health-probes.lock lease; a probe that couldn't run (exit 3 with stderr, other code, no start, killed) is logged once per new failure and again when it recovers; HEALTH.md section 6 (M.ORCH-T2037); d73216f2 Health view in the global tab's Misc area: one card per probe check (status, reading, the line it was graded against with learned/configured, a sparkline of its readings and the recent-grade strip, its output line), the overall status in the HEALTH header, an empty note before any report (M.ORCH-T2034); defbed4a Backup & Restore toolbar button enabled: BackupRestoreWindow offers Backup now (BackupService.Run over the roster's SQLite databases, the web apps' Azure SQL databases via Kickstart.List when ticked, and AppData, then AzureBlobUpload.UploadAndPrune with the default options when ticked) and Restore from folder (BackupRestore.Run on the picked folder, newest by default via BackupFolders.FindNewest), each with timestamped progress lines, off the UI thread, cancellable backup (M.ORCH-T2050)) | 4c07d0be |
